packageRules.description: The corelibs are vendored by scripts/bootstrap.sh, never resolved from a registry. drivers/go/go.mod carries `require github.com/sofa-buffers/corelib-go v0.0.0` only to satisfy the module graph; a `replace` directive points the build at ../../vendor/corelib-go, so the version string is inert. Bumping it changes nothing and misrepresents the harness as testing a released corelib instead of the freshly vendored family (PLAN §2, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Closed crucible#110 on these grounds.
